for n in range(1,17):

 path='/'+'-'.join(f'<int:{x}>' for x in names)
 m=Map([Rule(path,endpoint='e')]);m.update();a=m.bind('example.com')
 vals=list(range(100,100+n)); url='/'+'-'.join(map(str,vals))
 got=a.match(url)
 expected=('e',dict(zip(names,vals)))
 if got != expected: print('FAIL',n,got)
print('done')
